bio.text: Tim Burchett has represented Tennessee's 2nd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives since January 2019.
An East Tennessee native who grew up in Knoxville, he served eight years as Knox County Mayor, and before that 16 years in the state legislature, four in the State House and 12 in the State Senate.
He lives in the Gibbs Community of Knox County with his wife and daughter.
